# Is the next 5 points of crop insurance coverage worth what it costs?

> Free crop insurance coverage level calculator for farmers: compare 70, 75, 80 and 85 percent RP, RP-HPE or YP using your agent's quoted premiums. See the guarantee, break-even yield, what each extra 5 points costs and your net across yield and price scenarios. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
